name: YardTrailerManager
tagline: Every trailer, every slot, every hour on the clock – one live yard map for gate, jockeys and supervisors in Power Apps.
description: A complete yard management app for distribution centres, cross-docks, 3PLs and container depots: a live yard map of zones, slots and dock doors with drag-and-drop moves, trailer and container inventory with seal, load status and dwell, jockey move tasks, gate in and gate out with seal and duplicate checks, expected arrivals, detention / demurrage exposure per unit and carrier, reefer temperature and fuel alarms and power, hazmat and empties-only zone rules. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Live yard map of doors and zones with status, load, dwell, alarms and move targets
Drag and drop to request (or make) a move – validated against the zone rules
Zone rules: reefer power, empties only, hazmat, closed; door ranges and closed doors
Gate in / gate out with seal checks and duplicate-unit checks
Expected arrivals with late flags, walk-in gate in and a daily gate log
Jockey move board: Requested → In progress → Done, hot moves first
Release from door with load status, seal, ready flag and park-at task
Dwell, free time and detention / demurrage exposure per unit and carrier
Reefer temperature and fuel alarms, loaded reefers without power
Roles: yard supervisor, gate clerk, yard jockey
Bulk move to zone, ready, gate out, hot; history and undo
Power Fx outputs and events (InventoryCsv, SummaryJson, NewRecordJson)
